cards.title: Synonyms, antonyms and analogies
rule: A **synonym** has the same or nearly the same meaning: *big – large, begin – start, brave – courageous*. Choose the one that fits the **sentence**.
An **antonym** has the opposite meaning: *hot – cold, ancient – modern*. Many are made with a prefix: *possible – **im**possible, honest – **dis**honest, compatible – **in**compatible*.
Use **context clues**: words like *however, but, although, whereas* often show an opposite meaning; *and, also, in other words* show a similar meaning.
An **analogy** compares two pairs that have the same relationship: *hand : glove :: foot : sock* (what you wear on it). Find the link in the first pair, then apply it to the second.
Word parts help: *bene-* = good, *mal-* = bad, *chron-* = time, *auto-* = self: *benefit, malnutrition, chronological, autobiography*.
cards.pattern: synonym = same · antonym = opposite · A : B :: C : D (same link)

cards.title: Notes
body: **Exam method:** read the whole sentence, cover the options, think of your own word, then choose the option closest to it.
Check the word class: a noun must be replaced by a noun, an adjective by an adjective.
For analogies, say the link as a sentence: "A glove is worn on a hand" → "A sock is worn on a foot".

cards.title: Worked practice
cards.problem: The effects of the traditional medicine were ________, lasting only a few minutes before the pain returned.

steps.text: **Step 1: Look at the sentence.** The context 'lasting only a few minutes' indicates that the effects were short-lived, requiring an adjective meaning temporary.
**Step 2: Watch out for the trap.** Students often confuse 'potent' (powerful) or 'inevitable' (unavoidable) with the correct option.

cards.title: Quick check
cards.q: The effects of the traditional medicine were ________, lasting only a few minutes before the pain returned.
cards.why:
**Step 1: Look at the sentence**
The context 'lasting only a few minutes' indicates that the effects were short-lived, requiring an adjective meaning temporary.

**Step 2: Watch out for the trap**
Students often confuse 'potent' (powerful) or 'inevitable' (unavoidable) with the correct option. 'Ephemeral' (Option B) is the precise academic synonym for short-lived.

**Step 3: In Tigrinya**
'Ephemeral' (ሳሕቲ/ኣዝዩ ሕጽር ዝበለ ግዜ ዝጸንሕ) ዝብል ቃል፡ ንሓጺር እዋን ጥራይ ዝጸንሕ ኩነታት ንምግላጽ የገልግል። እቲ ሓረግ 'lasting only a few minutes' (ንሒደት ደቓይቕ ጥራይ ዝጸንሐ) ስለ ዝበለ፡ ቅኑዕ መልሲ Option B እዩ።

cards.title: Worked practice
cards.problem: Unlike his highly ________ predecessor, the new director was malevolent and treated the employees with cruelty.

steps.text: **Step 1: Look at the sentence.** The contrastive conjunction 'Unlike' indicates that the blank must contain the antonym of 'malevolent' (evil-wishing/cruel).
**Step 2: Watch out for the trap.** Students must identify 'benevolent' (Option B - kind/well-wishing) as the exact antonym of 'malevolent'.

cards.title: Quick check
cards.q: Unlike his highly ________ predecessor, the new director was malevolent and treated the employees with cruelty.
cards.why:
**Step 1: Look at the sentence**
The contrastive conjunction 'Unlike' indicates that the blank must contain the antonym of 'malevolent' (evil-wishing/cruel).

**Step 2: Watch out for the trap**
Students must identify 'benevolent' (Option B - kind/well-wishing) as the exact antonym of 'malevolent'. Both words share the root '-volent' (wishing), with 'bene-' (good) and 'male-' (bad) prefixes.

**Step 3: In Tigrinya**
'Unlike' (ዘይከም) ዝብል ናይ መነጻጸሪ ቃል ስለ ዘሎ፡ እቲ ባዶ ቦታ ናይ 'malevolent' (እኩይ/ጨካን) ኣንጻር ቃል ክኸውን ኣለዎ። 'Benevolent' (ርሕሩሕ/ደግ) ምስቲ 'bene-' (ጽቡቕ) ዝብል ናይ ላቲን ሱር ዝተኣሳሰር ኮይኑ ቅኑዕ ኣንጻር ቃል እዩ (Option B)።

cards.title: Worked practice
cards.problem: Choose the option that correctly completes the analogy: **Carpenter : Saw :: Surgeon : ________**

steps.text: **Step 1: Look at the sentence.** The relationship is Worker-and-Tool (Worker : Tool).
A carpenter uses a saw as his primary tool, in the same way that a surgeon uses a scalpel as his primary tool.

cards.title: Quick check
cards.q: Choose the option that correctly completes the analogy: **Carpenter : Saw :: Surgeon : ________**
cards.why:
**Step 1: Look at the sentence**
The relationship is Worker-and-Tool (Worker : Tool). A carpenter uses a saw as his primary tool, in the same way that a surgeon uses a scalpel as his primary tool.

**Step 2: Watch out for the trap**
Students often choose 'Operation' (Option D) or 'Hospital' (Option B) because they are related to surgery, but they do not match the specific Worker-and-Tool logical relationship. Option C is correct.

**Step 3: In Tigrinya**
እዚ ናይ ስነ-ሞጎት ዝምድና 'ሰራሕተኛን መሳርሒኡን' (Worker-and-Tool) የርእየና። ጸራቢ ዕንጨይቲ (carpenter) ንመጋዝ (saw) ከም መሳርሒኡ ይጥቀመሉ፤ ከምኡ ውን ሓኪም መጥባሕቲ (surgeon) ንመጥባሕቲ መላጸ (scalpel) ከም መሳርሒኡ ይጥቀመሉ (Option C)።

why: Answer D: quiet and not openly expressing feelings
